content:
maya: Need to provision a new GPU nodepool in us-central1 for low-latency batch inference. Target ~40 nodes initially. Prefer H100 for the primary inference pool but fallback to A10G if quotas/availability block us. Requirements: AZ spread, ClusterAutoscaler integration, preemptible burst fallback, taints for infer-prod, and static egress IPs. Who can take the quota request + sizing calc? cc @samir @jia :rocket:

samir: I can drive the quota request. Quick Q: is this for SLA-backed Dedicated capacity or best-effort batch? If SLA, we should avoid preemptible on the primary pool.

maya: SLA-backed for two customers. We can still have a secondary preemptible pool for burst training. Primary must keep steady latency.

jia: H100 gives a big perf bump for long sequences, but cost is ~2x A10G. If models are quantized int8, A10G might be sufficient. Also check H100 stock in us-central1 — sometimes limited.

leo: Proposal: two node pools
- infer-prod-h100 (reserved, min=4, desired=10, max=12, taint gpu=infer:NoSchedule)
- infer-burst-a10g-preemptible (preemptible, min=0, desired=30, max=40, tolerations allowed)
Use nodeSelector: "redwood.ai/workload: infer" and set podAffinity to prefer lower p99 latency. Also CA config snippet below. :thumbsup:

```
# cluster-autoscaler gke node group annotation example
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: cluster-autoscaler-config
spec:
  template:
    metadata:
      annotations:
        cluster-autoscaler.kubernetes.io/safe-to-evict: "false"
# nodepool settings (terraform/GKE):
# minSize = 4, maxSize = 12, initialNodeCount = 10, preemptible = false for prod
```

ops-bot: Quota check: Project gpu-rl-infer currently at 42/50 GPUs in us-central1. H100 quota = 0/4 (none available). https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas?filters=GPU :eyes:

samir: I'll file a GCP quota increase (request +60 A10G, +20 H100) and link billing. Filing ticket now, will add justification: low-latency inference for paying customers + autoscaling safety buffer. Ticket GCP-QUOTA-9287.

jia: Remember to enable the gpu-driver DaemonSet and node-feature-discovery if we want MIG on A100/A10G. If we go H100, confirm CUDA + cuDNN versions in our runtime images. Add a preemption handling policy in runtime to checkpoint/KV-cache spill to redis and fallback to hosted API when pods lost.

leo: I'll draft the terraform diff: add two google_container_node_pool resources, set autoscaling block, add node taints & labels, and create a static NAT for the pools' egress IPs. Also set maxUnavailable=1 in rolling updates. Will open PR once quota confirmed.

maya: Great. Samir, ping this thread when quota is updated. Leo, please include cost estimate in PR (monthly $/node * count + preemptible savings). Jia, add runtime fallback notes to the ops-runbook.

samir: Will do. Filed quota request and added cost justification. GCP replied with pre-approval pending billing verification. :white_check_mark:

maya: Thanks all — plan sounds good. Once H100 quota confirmed we prefer to start prod on H100; otherwise we'll flip to A10G and document perf delta. :eyes:
